title: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin through 4.4.6 does not sanitise or escape a custom styling value before storing it…
description: The Popup Builder WordPress plugin up to version 4.4.6 contains a vulnerability where it does not sanitize or escape a custom styling value before storing and rendering it on pages with popups. This allows users with popup management permissions, which can be assigned to lower-privileged roles, to inject JavaScript that executes in the browsers of all visitors, including logged-in administrators.
